event_var.var_meaning: Overall survival event indicator; inferred coding: '1' = death, '0' = censored (alive)

notes: Variables 'OS' and 'OS.time' are present in the provided supplementary data (Tongji cohort; 30 samples).

OS.time unit is not explicitly stated in the supplementary snippet; 'years' is inferred because the manuscript reports 2- and 3-year calibration curves and the numeric range of OS.time (~0.05–5.09) is consistent with years of follow-up.

Event coding (1 vs 0) is not explicitly defined in the paper or supplementary snippet; the mapping '1' = death, '0' = censored (alive) is inferred from patterns in the data (cases with very small OS.time often have OS=1) and common convention.
Tongji cohort (described in Methods) corresponds to GEO accession GSE201868 per the Data availability statement; the supplied supplementary table rows correspond to that cohort.
